text:
elena_pm: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Need concrete windows + acceptance criteria so PMs can finalize customer notes: (A) API batching primitives (B) Console delta rollout (canary -> beta -> GA) (C) Optimize suggestion engine (passive vs auto-apply). Can leads drop specifics here?

carl_vp: TL;DR: batching canary late-July, beta mid-Aug, GA in Sept; Console internal canary next week, external beta in 3w, GA late-Aug; Optimize passive surfacing in Sept, auto-apply is a Q4 project and gated on audit/undo UX.

rachel_prod: Console details: internal delta canary (10% of org) kicks off 2025-07-08, external invited beta starts 2025-07-29, GA target 2025-08-25. Acceptance: per-route enablement, rollout health dashboard, no critical errors for 72h, support playbook published.

dan_engineering: Batching notes: runtime PR merged but we hit a memory uptick on old-gen T4 clusters. Canary window proposed 2025-07-20 -> 2025-07-27. Acceptance checklist (draft):
```
- p50 <= baseline +5%
- p95 <= baseline +20%
- no increase in 5xx rate > 0.1%
- KV cache delta < 12%
- stress test for sequence length 8k passed
```
I'll surface perf artifacts to the infra runbook.

maria_support: Support asks: please publish a 1-page beta FAQ and a "what to do if latency regresses" checklist before external beta. Also include contact rota.

elena_pm: @rachel_prod can you confirm the external beta cohort criteria? we want ~15 customers across small/medium/enterprise and at least two router-heavy workloads.

rachel_prod: Confirmed rough list ready: 10 SMBs, 3 mid-market, 2 enterprise (both okayed by legal). I'll DM the list and post the acceptance doc to the roadmap doc by EOD.

carl_vp: Optimize specifics: Phase 1 = Console-only hints + API "recommendation" field (read-only). Phase 2 = opt-in wizard that can apply quant/kv-cache settings. Phase 2 acceptance includes: audit logs, undo, and customer explicit consent. Tentative Phase 1 date: 2025-09-10. Phase 2 earliest: 2025-11-15 subject to compliance.

dan_engineering: One more engineering risk: model-compat checks for quant profiles are incomplete. If those fail, we'll stall Phase 2. Working on a compatibility matrix.

maria_support: +1 on audit log requirement. Also ask SRE to add a few synthetic checks that exercise the suggestion path during canary.

deploy-bot: Canary ticket created: INF-4882. Schedule: 2025-07-20T08:00Z -> 2025-07-27T08:00Z. Will notify #eng-oncall and create a rollback runbook link.

elena_pm: Great. Action items: Rachel publish beta list + acceptance doc by EOD; Dan push perf artifacts + compatibility matrix by EOD Thurs; Maria we need your beta FAQ by 2025-07-15. Leads, drop final dates in the shared roadmap (link in #product) so I can freeze customer comms.

carl_vp: If any blocker persists after initial perf runs we'll do a short leadership sync. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
